questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GHOST’ is written as 'ONGCB' and 'ABIDE' is written as 'UTMRQ'. How will 'RULES' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

**Opposite Letter - 5**

So,

**'GHOST’ is written as 'ONGCB'**

 
• G = T (opposite) - 5 = O
 
• H = S - 5 = N
 
• O = L - 5 = G
 
• S = H - 5 = C
 
• T = G - 5 = B

​And,

**'ABIDE' is written as 'UTMRQ'**

 
• A = Z (opposite) - 5 = U
 
• B = Y - 5 = T
 
• I = R- 5 = M
 
• D = W - 5 = R
 
• E = V - 5 = Q

 

​Similarly, 

**​****'RULES' is written as :**​

 
• R = I (opposite) - 5 = D
 
• U = F - 5 = A
 
• L = O- 5 = J
 
• E = V - 5 = Q
 
• S = H - 5 = C

 

Hence, "**DAJQC**" is the correct answer.
